 Bolex Reporter, Volume 15
 1965
 Volume 15, Number 1
 Articles: "Visual Information", Douglas McKinny; "Sales Training", KC Gillespie; "Manufacturing Methods", Leslie H. McWilliam; "Time Lapse", Jack Kath; "Operating Room", Ely I. Bergmann; "Critical Camera Work", Don Wong; "Living Cells", Dr. James M. Klinkhamer; "Cinephotomicrography", James R.C. Fonseca; "Red China and Cuba", Heiner Gautschy, Ph.D.; "Low-cost Productions", Fred A. Henninger; "Tahiti Travelogue", Stanton Waterman; "Skiing, Climing, Filming", Hans Gmoser; "Delving the Depths", Hank Frey; "Sky, Water and Blondes", Ron Church; "Animation", Rosco Wright; "Movie Worth 1,000 Words", Mark J. Klayman; "Camp Promotion", Gerard J. Jannone; "Visual Education", Nathan Gifford; "Camera Versatility", Ernst Wildi
 In 1965, the Bolex Reporter devoted three issues to the professional motion picture producer. The articles cover a variety of topics such as filming for industry, medicine and research, zoology, photo journalism, television commercials, underwater, school and educational films, as well as using motion pictures on a lecture circuit. The 'Technical Corner' covers techniques and ideas for film makers, and a product review lists many of the new and current Bolex cameras and accessories for professional applications. Among the new products listed are the beveled splicer, ball-joint tripod head and perfectone motor. A 400' magazine modification is mentioned as being available in Fall of 1965; two years before the REX-5 was available.
